lines: This building sorts more than four hundred thousand packages an hour.
Five point two million square feet.
Some planes don't even stop on the ramp.
They pull right up to the building, nose first,
like a car into a garage.
Every box goes through a tunnel of cameras that reads the label from every side.
There are more than a hundred and fifty miles of conveyor belts in this building.
ZERO decides to follow his box.
ZERO does not follow his box.
